name: faq-split-view
title: FAQ Split View
description: Question list on one side and the selected answer in a large panel on the other. Keyboard friendly tab pattern.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; question: ReactNode; answer: ReactNode }[]

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Id of the question selected first. Defaults to the first one.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds the answer takes to fade in.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
